title: Intervals: Pattern recognition and reusable templates

scenes.title: Mental model
bullets: Sort ranges by a boundary, then reason about overlap using the last accepted or currently merged interval.

scenes.title: State contract
bullets: Processed intervals are represented by a correct non-overlapping summary, and only the last summary interval can overlap the next sorted one.

scenes.title: Implementation sequence
bullets: compare next start with active end

scenes.title: Worked reasoning
bullets: When merging, if next.start <= current.end, extend current.end; otherwise emit current and start a new range.

scenes.title: Complexity proof
bullets: O(n log n) for sorting and O(n) for scanning; output may require O(n) space.
